translations.Replace the body of this component with: Replace the body of this component with whatever bespoke behaviour your page needs — realtime UI, vendor integrations, anything that does not fit the built-in page types.
translations.This is the canonical example of a custo: This is the canonical example of a custom-type page in the manifest renderer pattern. It is rendered when a manifest page declares `type: "custom"` and `component: "CustomExample"`.
translations.app-availability.title: Required application unavailable
translations.app-availability.description: This application requires OpenRegister to be installed and enabled.
translations.The public portal signs supplier/client: The public portal signs supplier/client sessions with a secret dedicated to this app — never the Nextcloud instance secret.
translations.A dedicated signing secret is configured: A dedicated signing secret is configured. The portal auth edge is safe to use.
translations.No dedicated signing secret is configure: No dedicated signing secret is configured yet. The portal cannot issue or accept sessions until the next install/upgrade repair step runs.
translations.Revoke all sessions for this organisatio: Revoke all sessions for this organisation
